contract.unconfigured: Both account facades and their bound messages use independent legacy Markdown by default. Canonical methods remain plain across selected backends.
contract.configured: Explicit parser configuration is shared by canonical methods, both styles and bound views. Per-call undefined/null inherit; false disables one call.
contract.disabled: Constructor false/null disable. Constructor undefined leaves defaults unconfigured. Calling setParseMode or assigning parseMode with false/null/undefined explicitly disables globally.
contract.scopes: withBackend copies both parser identity and whether configuration exists, including explicit disable. Later parent/child settings remain independent.
contract.precedence: FormattedText and explicit entities bypass default parsing. Empty per-item album modes inherit, false disables. Keyboard text labels remain literal even with custom parsers.
contract.boundary: High-level-only GramJS/teleproto receive explicit canonical disable or the owned facade parser; vendor defaults cannot determine canonical message interpretation.

differences: Canonical defaults intentionally remain plain; SDK-style defaults match each pinned SDK constructor.

Native request bytes match the current schema; old GramJS request bytes match through its own serializer and through a separately translated current-schema request. This does not implement the old-schema result bridge.
The pinned GramJS model patch loses the text setter; the comparison invokes its original CustomMessage setter directly. Owned setters remain available.
Owned callbacks retain finite input/output/entity bounds and validation before upload consumption.
remaining: Complete media options and file inference
